name: sar_bridge
description: SAR speckle despeckling via classical adaptive filters (Lee, Frost, Kuan). Reduces speckle noise in SAR imagery so downstream classical land-cover analysis is more reliable. Does not perform SAR-to-optical translation — no trained model exists for that here.

sar_image_path.description: Path to the input SAR image (GeoTIFF)

filter_type.description: Classical adaptive despeckle filter to apply

bridged_image_path.description: Path to the despeckled output image
